import { APIResource } from '../../core/resource.js';
import type { RequestOptions } from '../../core/transport.js';
import type {
  JsonValue,
} from '../models.js';

/**
 * Operations tagged `Runs`.
 */
export class RunsResource extends APIResource {
  /**
   * `DELETE /runs/{runId}`
   */
  delete(runId: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<void> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'DELETE',
      path: `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(String(runId))}`,
      responseType: 'void',
      options,
    });
  }

  /**
   * `GET /runs/{runId}`
   */
  getRun(runId: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<JsonValue> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(String(runId))}`,
      options,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Collides with getRun after shortening, so both keep their ids
   *
   * `GET /runs/latest`
   */
  getRuns(options?: RequestOptions): Promise<JsonValue> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: '/runs/latest',
      options,
    });
  }

  /**
   * Must keep its full name: `listAgent` would lie
   *
   * `GET /agents/{agentId}/runs`
   */
  listAgentRuns(agentId: string, options?: RequestOptions): Promise<JsonValue> {
    return this._client.request({
      method: 'GET',
      path: `/agents/${encodeURIComponent(String(agentId))}/runs`,
      options,
    });
  }
}

// Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

import type { Transport } from '../../core/transport.js';
import { AgentsResource } from './agents.js';
import { RunsResource } from './runs.js';

export * from './agents.js';
export * from './runs.js';

/**
 * Every resource group exposed on the client, keyed by its accessor name.
 */
export interface Resources {
  readonly agents: AgentsResource;
  readonly runs: RunsResource;
}

export function createResources(client: Transport): Resources {
  return {
    agents: new AgentsResource(client),
    runs: new RunsResource(client),
  };
}
